acts.title: The Cliffside Summit
acts.description: Perched 500 meters sheer above Lake Lucerne, Switzerland's architectural mountain pinnacle.
acts.fact: 💡 LOCATION: 500M SHEER CLIFFTOP OVER LAKE LUCERNE

acts.title: Historic Red Railway
acts.description: Ascending through pristine pine forests via private lake catamaran and red cliff funicular.

acts.title: Quartz Stone Modernism
acts.description: Swiss oak timber, double-sided glass fireplaces, and bathtubs overlooking misty alpine peaks.
acts.fact: 💡 DESIGN: FLOOR-TO-CEILING GLASS WALL ALPINE ARCHITECTURE

acts.title: Cantilevered Mountain Pool
acts.description: Hovering in heated thermal waters directly over the 1,500-foot abyss of Lake Lucerne.
acts.fact: 💡 POOL: WORLD'S GREATEST CANTILEVERED HEATED INFINITY POOL

acts.title: Tri-Level Thermal Wellness
acts.description: 10,000 square meters of panoramic saunas, saline floating pools, and private alpine gardens.
acts.fact: 💡 SPA: 10,000 SQM SWITZERLAND'S LARGEST ALPINE SPA

acts.title: Lucerne Panorama Toast
acts.description: Fine Swiss pinot noir by the terrace fire as town lights shimmer below snowy Alpine peaks.
acts.fact: 💡 SUNSET: TWILIGHT PANORAMA OVER 4 CANTONS & MT. PILATUS
